column1: New research sheds light on the disappearance of an ancient society
column2: 新研究为一个古代社会何以消失提供了线索。

column1: The Harappan Civilisation of ancient Pakistan and India flourished 5,000 years ago, but a thousand years later their cities were abandoned.
column2: 五千年前，哈拉帕文明在今天的巴基斯坦和印度一带兴盛起来；一千年后，那里的城市却被居民弃置。
column5: a thousand years later|一千年后

column1: The Harappan Civilisation was a sophisticated Bronze Age society who built ‘megacities’ and traded internationally in luxury craft products, and yet seemed to have left almost no depictions of themselves.
column2: 哈拉帕文明是一个高度发达的青铜时代社会。其居民建造了“巨型城市”，还把奢华的手工艺品销往国外，然而他们似乎几乎没有留下描绘自己形象的作品。
column7: luxury craft products|奢华的手工艺品

column1: But their lack of self-imagery — at a time when the Egyptians were carving and painting representations of themselves all over their temples — is only part of the mystery.
column2: 当时的埃及人在神庙各处雕刻、绘制自己的形象。相比之下，哈拉帕人几乎没留下自己的图像，而这只是谜团的一部分。
column3: lack of self-imagery|缺少描绘自身的图像
column7: part of the mystery|谜团的一部分

column1: ‘There is plenty of archaeological evidence to tell us about the rise of the Harappan Civilisation, but relatively little about its fall,’ explains archaeologist Dr Cameron Petrie of the University of Cambridge.
column2: “关于哈拉帕文明的兴起，我们有大量考古证据；关于它的衰落，证据就相对少了。”剑桥大学的考古学家卡梅伦·皮特里博士解释道。

column1: ‘As populations increased, cities were built that had great baths, craft workshops, palaces and halls laid out in distinct sectors.
column2: “随着人口增加，城市相继建成。城内的大浴池、手工业作坊、宫殿和会堂分布在各自独立的街区。

column1: Houses were arranged in blocks, with wide main streets and narrow alleyways, and many had their own wells and drainage systems.
column2: 住宅按街区排列，主街宽阔，巷道狭窄，许多住宅还有自己的水井和排水系统。

column1: It was very much a “thriving” civilisation.’
column2: 这确实是个‘欣欣向荣’的文明。”

column1: Then around 2100 BC, a transformation began.
column2: 随后，大约公元前2100年，一场转变开始了。

column1: Streets went uncleaned, buildings started to be abandoned, and ritual structures fell out of use.
column2: 街道无人清扫，房屋开始遭人弃置，礼仪性建筑也渐渐不再使用。
column6: fell out of use|逐渐不再使用

column1: After their final demise, a millennium passed before really large-scale cities appeared once more in South Asia.
column2: 这些城市最终消亡后，过了一千年，南亚才再次出现真正具有相当规模的城市。

column1: Some have claimed that major glacier-fed rivers changed their course, dramatically affecting the water supply and agriculture; or that the cities could not cope with an increasing population, they exhausted their resource base, the trading economy broke down or they succumbed to invasion and conflict; and yet others that climate change caused an environmental change that affected food and water provision.
column2: 有人认为，靠冰川融水补给的大河发生改道，严重影响了供水和农业；也有人提出，城市无法应对人口增长，赖以生存的资源耗尽，贸易经济瓦解，或是城市毁于入侵和冲突；还有人认为，气候变化引起环境改变，进而影响食物和水的供应。
column3: glacier-fed rivers|靠冰川融水补给的河流

column1: ‘It is unlikely that there was a single cause for the decline of the civilisation.
column2: “这个文明的衰落不大可能只有一个原因。

column1: But the fact is, until now, we have had little solid evidence from the area for most of the key elements,’ said Petrie.
column2: 但事实是，迄今为止，对于大多数关键因素，我们掌握的来自当地的确凿证据都很少。”皮特里说。

column1: ‘A lot of the archaeological debate has really only been well-argued speculation.’
column2: “考古学界的许多争论，其实都只是论证周密的推测。”

column1: A research team led by Petrie, together with Dr Ravindanath Singh of Banaras Hindu University in India, found early in their investigations that many of the archaeological sites were not where they were supposed to be, completely altering understanding of the way that this region was inhabited in the past.
column2: 皮特里带领的研究团队与印度贝拿勒斯印度教大学的拉文德拉纳特·辛格博士合作。在调查初期，他们就发现许多考古遗址并不在原先以为的位置；这彻底改变了人们对该地区古代聚居格局的认识。
column7: were supposed to be|原以为所在的地方

column1: When they carried out a survey of how the larger area was settled in relation to sources of water, they found inaccuracies in the published geographic locations of ancient settlements ranging from several hundred metres to many kilometres.
column2: 他们调查了更广阔地区的聚落与水源之间的位置关系，发现已发表资料记载的古代聚落位置存在误差，小到几百米，大到许多千米。
column3: carried out a survey|开展调查

column1: They realised that any attempts to use the existing data were likely to be fundamentally flawed.
column2: 他们意识到，任何试图沿用现有数据的做法都很可能从根本上就有问题。

column1: Over the course of several seasons of fieldwork they carried out new surveys, finding an astonishing 198 settlement sites that were previously unknown.
column2: 在随后的几个田野工作季里，他们重新开展调查，竟发现了198处此前未知的聚落遗址。

column1: Now, research published by Dr Yama Dixit and Professor David Hodell, both from Cambridge’s Department of Earth Sciences, has provided the first definitive evidence for climate change affecting the plains of north-western India, where hundreds of Harappan sites are known to have been situated.
column2: 如今，剑桥大学地球科学系的亚玛·迪克西特博士和戴维·霍德尔教授发表了一项研究。它首次提供了确凿证据，表明气候变化波及印度西北部平原，那里已知有数百处哈拉帕遗址。
column4: Department of Earth Sciences|地球科学系

column1: The researchers gathered shells of Melanoides tuberculata snails from the sediments of an ancient lake and used geochemical analysis as a means of tracing the climate history of the region.
column2: 研究者从一处古湖泊的沉积物中采集了瘤拟黑螺的螺壳，并用地球化学分析追溯该地区的气候史。
column7: as a means of|作为……的手段

column1: ‘As today, the major source of water into the lake is likely to have been the summer monsoon,’ says Dixit.
column2: “当时很可能和今天一样，流入湖中的水主要来自夏季季风带来的降雨。”迪克西特说。
column4: major source of water|主要水源
column5: likely to have been|过去很可能是

column1: ‘But we have observed that there was an abrupt change about 4,100 years ago, when the amount of evaporation from the lake exceeded the rainfall — indicative of a drought.’
column2: “但我们观察到，约4100年前突然发生了变化，当时湖水的蒸发量超过降雨量，表明当地出现了干旱。”

column1: Hodell adds: ‘We estimate that the weakening of the Indian summer monsoon climate lasted about 200 years before recovering to the previous conditions, which we still see today.’
column2: 霍德尔补充说：“据我们估计，印度夏季季风减弱的状态持续了约200年，之后才恢复到先前的状况，那也正是我们今天所见的状况。”

column1: It has long been thought that other great Bronze Age civilisations also declined at a similar time, with a global-scale climate event being seen as the cause.
column2: 人们长期以来一直认为，其他伟大的青铜时代文明也在大致相同的时期衰落，其原因被认为是一次全球规模的气候事件。
column3: has long been thought|长期以来被认为
column5: at a similar time|在大致相同的时期

column1: While it is possible that these local-scale processes were linked, the real archaeological interest lies in understanding the impact of these larger-scale events on different environments and different populations.
column2: 这些局部变化过程有可能彼此关联。不过，考古学家真正关心的是，这些较大尺度的事件对不同环境和不同人群产生了怎样的影响。
column3: local-scale processes|局部尺度的变化过程
column5: archaeological interest|考古学所关注的问题

column1: ‘Considering the vast area of the Harappan Civilisation with its variable weather systems,’ explains Singh, ‘it is essential that we obtain more climate data from areas close to the two great cities at Mohenjodaro and Harappa and also from the Indian Punjab.’
column2: “考虑到哈拉帕文明地域辽阔，各地天气系统不一，”辛格解释道，“我们必须从摩亨佐达罗、哈拉帕这两大城市附近以及印度旁遮普地区取得更多气候数据。”
column4: variable weather systems|各异的天气系统

column1: Petrie and Singh’s team is now examining archaeological records and trying to understand details of how people led their lives in the region five millennia ago.
column2: 皮特里与辛格的团队如今正在考察考古记录，想更细致地了解五千年前这里的人们过着怎样的生活。

column1: They are analysing grains cultivated at the time, and trying to work out whether they were grown under extreme conditions of water stress, and whether they were adjusting the combinations of crops they were growing for different weather systems.
column2: 他们正在分析当时种植的谷物，试图弄清这些谷物是否生长在极度缺水的条件下，以及人们是否会根据不同的天气系统调整所种作物的搭配。

column1: They are also looking at whether the types of pottery used, and other aspects of their material culture, were distinctive to specific regions or were more similar across larger areas.
column2: 他们还在考察，当时所用的陶器种类和物质文化的其他方面，是各地区独有，还是在更大范围内比较相似。
column8: across larger areas|在更大范围内

column1: This gives us insight into the types of interactive networks that the population was involved in, and whether those changed.
column2: 这有助于我们了解当时的居民参与了哪些交往网络，以及这些网络是否发生过变化。
column3: gives us insight into|帮助我们深入了解

column1: Petrie believes that archaeologists are in a unique position to investigate how past societies responded to environmental and climatic change.
column2: 皮特里认为，考古学家在研究过去的社会如何应对环境与气候变化方面拥有独特的条件。
column3: in a unique position|具备独特条件

column1: ‘By investigating responses to environmental pressures and threats, we can learn from the past to engage with the public, and the relevant governmental and administrative bodies, to be more proactive in issues such as the management and administration of water supply, the balance of urban and rural development, and the importance of preserving cultural heritage in the future.’
column2: “研究人们如何应对环境压力和威胁，可以让我们汲取历史经验，与公众及相关政府部门和行政机构合作，更主动地处理供水的管理和行政事务、城乡均衡发展等问题，并重视今后保护文化遗产的重要性。”
column10: urban and rural development|城乡发展
